sources.title: ViT-B-32__openai huggingface.co api & immich-app ViT-B-32__openai ...
sources.snippet: ViT-B-32__openai is an open source model from GitHub that offers a free installation service, and any user can find ViT-B-32__openai on GitHub to install. At the same time, huggingface.co provides the effect of ViT-B-32__openai install, users can directly use ViT-B-32__openai installed effect in huggingface.co for debugging and trial. It also supports api for free installation.

sources.title: OpenAI CLIP (ViT-B/32) - Vision-Language Embedding Model - exploreai.tools
sources.snippet: OpenAI CLIP (ViT-B/32) is a vision-language model that generates embeddings for images and text, enabling similarity, retrieval, and ranking tasks without task-specific training.
